headline: Nevish Line Surges While Weathered Expanse Falls Silent
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the Nevish Line has taken the lead wire with 52 transfers on the day and nine in the last two hours to the hour of filing, centred on Grief Mother, Mistle Shrine, Princefal and the Scrying Belt, holding one Warden, five Colonial and two ruined posts on reported losses of 11,865 Colonial and 14,123 Warden in the day. The Weathered Expanse, busiest at last report, has gone quiet in the last two hours with 48 on the day to 1555 about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, holding seven Warden and two ruined posts. Linn Mercy stirs anew with two in two hours to 1755, 36 on the day about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch. Fresh movement shows at Briar in Stlican Shelf with three in two hours. Callahan's Passage with 14 on the day about Crumbling Post, Marban Hollow with 11 about Checkpoint Bua, and Mooring County with 16 about the Wind Hills each report nothing in two hours, while Stonecradle remains still since yesterday with eight on the day.
